name: Wiki Special Pink Color Lip Balm 20ml Moisturizing Natural Tint Smooth Hydrating Formula for Soft Lips
description:
Keep your lips soft, smooth, and beautifully tinted with the Wiki Special Pink Color Lip Balm. Enriched with natural moisturizing ingredients like shea and mango butter, this balm deeply hydrates, repairs chapped lips, and adds a gentle pink tint that enhances your natural lip color. Its lightweight, non-sticky texture ensures comfortable all-day wear, while Vitamin E and licorice extract nourish and help even out lip tone. Perfect for daily use, it delivers a natural glow and long-lasting moisture for healthy, kissably soft lips.Key Features:
 Volume: 20ml
 Infused with shea and mango butter for deep nourishment
 Vitamin E and licorice extract brighten and repair lips
 Natural pink tint adjusts to your lip tone
 Smooth, lightweight, and non-sticky texture
 Locks in moisture for all-day hydration
 Suitable for all skin types and all seasonsHow to Use:
 Twist open and apply a small amount on clean lips
 Glide smoothly across the lips for an even tint
 Reapply as needed for added shine or moisture
 Can be used alone or under lipstickSafety Information:
 For external use only
 Avoid direct contact with eyes
 Discontinue use if irritation develops
 Store in a cool, dry place away from heat and sunlight

Package Includes:
 1 × Wiki Special Pink Color Lip Balm (20ml)
